exposure: Mode of feeding (Breastfeeding vs Formula feeding)
Mode of delivery (Caesarean section vs Vaginal)
cohort: 31 mother-neonate pairs (25 caesarean section and 6 vaginal deliveries)
finding: A core gut microbiota, independent of delivery mode and lactation stage, was identified in neonates, suggesting the existence of foundational microbial communities.
mod_finding: The study examined gut microbiota development in neonates, finding a 'core' microbiota independent of delivery mode but noting delivery mode as a factor influencing early gut microbiota.
